summary: CDP transport paces the real API call with an adaptive limiter and returns a typed RateLimitError on 429 instead of decoding throttle bodies as empty results.
reason: The CDP GraphQL branch returned before the generated limiter and 429-retry loop ran, so browser-transport reads had no pacing and swallowed throttling (a 429 body flowed onward as a GraphQL payload decoding into empty results). Fix lives in the novel internal/cdp package: package-level cliutil.NewAdaptiveLimiterAuto(2.0) waited on before the in-page fetch; status 429 triggers OnRateLimit() and returns *cliutil.RateLimitError; success paths call OnSuccess(). Localhost CDP discovery calls are not paced.
validated_outcome: internal/cdp test suite (9 tests) green; live reads still pass; 429 now surfaces as a typed error.
